intro: Scavenging Deathknell is an early logistical task assigned to newly awakened Forsaken by Deathguard Saltain in Deathknell. As freshly raised undead claw their way from the soil, the Forsaken must scavenge abandoned boxes and crates throughout the blighted settlement to equip incoming recruits. It illustrates the raw scarcity facing Sylvanas's nascent people, who must reclaim discarded goods simply to survive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You there! If you're looking for something to make yourself useful, then listen up!

We need fresh out-of-the-ground recruits to head into Deathknell and search for any sort of useful equipment. Most likely, they'll be in stacks of boxes. We expect more recruits to be rising soon, and unless we want them to stumble about naked we had better get to scavenging!
Well get to work, you miserable bag of bones! I'm not going to reward those without some hustle.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us? There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside. No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great work friend. I knew you weren't useless. Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.
